title: Bhoomi
desc: After his daughter is brutally raped and the attackers are acquitted, a father decides to take revenge and bring the perpetrators to justice.

title: Entha Manchivaadavuraa
desc: Balu grows up without the love of a family due to his parents' untimely death. Later, he decides to establish a firm to help people like himself receive the affection they missed out on.

title: The Raja Saab
desc: RajaSaab's search for his estranged grandfather leads him to a haunted mansion. He learns that his grandfather Kanakaraju, an exorcist, has laid a trap to lure him.

title: Yevadu
desc: Satya gets a different face after he is almost killed, but a new face multiplies his problems. His ordeal begins when he leaves the hospital and has to deal with his lover's murderer.

title: Nuvvu Naaku Nachav
desc: Venky, an unemployed youth, heads to Hyderabad for a marriage ceremony. What seems like a brief vacation gradually turns into something more, when the soon-to-be bride falls for him.

title: Mangalavaaram
desc: Maaya becomes the new sub-inspector of a village gripped by mysterious murders. But as she begins to investigate, she uncovers a web of dark truths and conspiracies.

title: Yeto Vellipoyindhi Manasu
desc: Varun and Nithya, childhood sweethearts, navigate the ups and downs of life, facing multiple separations as they grow from childhood to adulthood.

title: Lovely
desc: Kittu and Lalli are internet friends who get nervous when it is time to meet. So, Kittu sends Akash in his place while Lalli sends Lavanya, who end up falling in love with each other.

title: Nuvva Nena
desc: A lawbreaker, Avinash, falls in love with Dr Nandini who already has a suitor, Anand, who is a patient. Eventually, Avinash and Anand discover that Dr Nandini is in love with someone else.

title: Bhale Bhale Magadivoy
desc: Lucky, an amnesiac scientist, is in love with Nandana, who is unaware of his condition. Things take a turn when he has to convince her parents for their marriage.

title: Mirai
desc: When a vicious villain sets out to claim nine sacred books that hold the secret to immortality, the guardian of the ninth book ties a happy-go-lucky orphan's destiny to the quest to protect them.

title: Aadi Keshava
desc: Following the death of his biological father, a man travels to Rayalaseema to protect his sister and his ancestral temple.

title: Balagam
desc: A young man in severe debt believes that the only way to pay it off is through the dowry from his impending marriage. However, the death of his grandfather puts his plan on hold.

title: Yamadonga
desc: Raja, an orphan whose dream is to become rich, falls in love with his childhood friend Mahi. However, he gets killed by her uncles and is sent to hell, where he creates havoc.
